utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m open to helping, Rey, but I need to know exactly who’s bringing which tools and where we’re storing everything before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. Gus already offered his drill, two ladders, and a basic toolbox, and Cleo’s keeping the supply list, so I can check with her about storage and tell you what’s still uncovered.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I’d still like the storage spot confirmed and a clear tool list before I say yes. Can you send me what Cleo has once she checks?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Quinn, last I heard they’re still aiming for this week, though Marcy did say it could slip a bit. Still, folks are planning for Saturday morning, and Mrs. Dalton’s meant to bring coffee if it goes ahead.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Good to know—if Saturday morning sticks, I’m going to keep spreading the word for the repair drive, so if you see anyone interested, send them by too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Quinn—I’ve already heard a few neighbors sounding keen, so I’ll send them your way if Saturday morning holds.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’d heard mixed things second-hand, but Rosa said she’s organizing it and it starts Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That lines up nicely—Faye can do 9:30 to 1:30, so the 10 o’clock start should work for her. I’m also pulling in a few folks from the garden group and block chat so we can round out the crew.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, that sounds like a solid crew already. I’ll keep passing along that it’s Rosa organizing and Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Dane, we’re meeting at the community center at nine—I’ve been repeating it to everyone so nobody misses the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m jumping in late again, Vik, but got it — community center at nine. I’ll be there, and I still think we should bring more extension cords and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Exactly, Dane—community center at nine, and I’ll keep repeating it around the block; extra extension cords and work gloves are a smart call.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I answer, can you confirm we’re still counting only the online form and not the paper list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, I’m not sure on the counting bit—Rosa is handling that. I’ve just got Saturday at 9 and I’m bringing my toolkit and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—thanks for clarifying what you know. Then I’ll hold off on the count until Rosa confirms the online form, and I’ll keep Saturday at 9 in mind.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira—I’m organizing the repair drive, and we’re starting Saturday at 9 in the community garden lot. If you want to pitch in, I’d love an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday might work, but can you confirm exactly who’s bringing the tools and where everything’s being stored before I commit?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I’m coordinating it, Bo is bringing a basic toolkit and a couple of extension cords, and I’ll have everything staged in the community garden lot Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sam, before I count on it, I need the start time confirmed and the drop-off spots listed plain and simple.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help, Eli—I’m sorting tools first, but if Leo confirms the start time and drop-off spots, I’ll pass them along plain and simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: All right, Sam—once Leo confirms whether it’s eight or nine and the drop-off spots, send it straight over and I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: If they still need people Saturday morning, I can be there from about 9:30 to 1:30 between drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps—have you already put your name on the online form, or should I add you there myself?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I haven’t filled it out yet, so if you can add me for that 9:30 to 1:30 window on Saturday, that’d be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s coming along pretty well, I think—we’ve got a decent pile of fixes lined up already. I still need to double-check whether we’re starting at eight or nine, though.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got us noted for 10-ish at the community center lot, not eight or nine. If that changes, tell me and I’ll update the drop-off list right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, 10-ish at the community center lot, thanks for catching that. I’ll stick with that unless my scribbled note says otherwise, and I’ll tell you if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, good to know people are pitching in—once you’ve got a proper count, tell me what still needs rounding up and I’ll help line it up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira—I’m still getting the count straight, but we’re meeting at the community center at nine, and I’ll let you know what we’re short on once I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect—I’m still out on errands, so just send me the list once you’ve got it and I’ll help round things up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, that helps—I’m marking down more extension cords and work gloves, and I’ll tally how many we should aim for next.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—that’ll help a lot. Let’s keep safety repairs like space heaters and lamps at the top, and tomorrow we can compare lists with Jules and see what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—I’ll keep extension cords and work gloves near the top, and tomorrow we can compare my list with Jules’s and fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ll be there by 9 with the drill, a couple ladders, the stud finder, and a basic toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—bring it all to the repair drive table when you get in, and I’ll get everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll bring everything to the repair drive table when I get there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Rosa, I’ve been telling everyone we’re meeting at the community center at nine for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for spreading the word, Vik, but I’m actually organizing it for Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot—not the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, thanks for correcting me, Rosa—I’ll start telling everyone it’s Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot instead.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pia, before I count on it, I need the start time confirmed—eight or nine—and the drop-off list by spot, starting with the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Quinn told me it starts at 10, not eight or nine, but I still don’t have a proper drop-off list by spot for the community center lot or anywhere else yet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, then let’s lock in 10 and get that drop-off list by spot written out, starting with the community center lot, before we tell folks anything else.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can put in a little, Nell—sorry it’s not more right now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s kind of you, Uli—thanks. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I think Rosa’s organizing it and it starts Saturday at 10 in the garden lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I’ll stop by Saturday and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s shaping up pretty well, Kira—we’ve already got the fence latch, Mrs. Alvarez’s porch step, and that busted bike tire on the list, and I’m pretty sure we’re starting at nine.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Pretty sure isn’t enough for me, Oren—can you confirm who’s actually bringing the tools and where everything’s being stored?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I should’ve checked before saying; I know the tools are being pooled for the drive, but I can’t honestly confirm who’s bringing what or where they’re all being stored just yet.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rey, I can handle the pickup run later—just send the list and addresses.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo—I’ll get the list from Cleo and send it over once she’s got the supplies pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—send it when you have it, and I’ll take care of the pickup run.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m pulling people in from a few different circles, and Faye can do about 9:30 to 1:30, so I’m trying to shape the repair drive around that window. If you’re in, I’d love to see what timing works for you too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That window could work on my end—I’m still finishing errands, but I can swing by once I’m done. Keep me posted if you pin down the timing, and I’ll help fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Ira—thanks. I’ll aim for that late-morning window and loop you in once I’ve pinned it down so we can plug you in where you’re most useful.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll be there by 9 with the drill, ladders, stud finder, and a basic toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Gus—thank you. We’re prioritizing space heaters, lamps, and other safety-related fixes first, so having your tools there by 9 will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it—I’ll be there at 9 with everything loaded up, and I’m happy to jump in wherever the safety fixes need me first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mina, we’re definitely still short on extension cords and work gloves—if you’ve got a sense of how many we should aim for, I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many people are on the online sign-up right now? Once we’ve got that count, we can set a number for cords and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I don’t have the sign-up count in front of me, but I can check it and then we’ll set a solid target for cords and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got us down for 10-ish at the community center lot, and I’m tracking the drop-off spots from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds about right to me—I’ve heard they’re still aiming for this weekend, though folks are keeping it a bit loose. I’ll keep passing along anything firmer I hear.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess—I’ve still got it logged as 10-ish this weekend at the community center lot, and I’ll update the drop-off list if anything gets pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Quinn, I’m blanking a little—was it the community center at nine for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Close—it’s this Saturday at the community shed starting at 10, and if you know anyone handy or curious, send them over too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the community shed at ten this Saturday. Thanks, I would’ve sent people to the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m starting with the donated tools now, and I’ll set aside anything that’s missing parts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Sam—if you need an extra set of hands, I can come by Saturday morning as long as it fits between drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye—that would be a big help, and Saturday morning should fit nicely between drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m late again, Hana, but I’d say maybe three more extension cords and around eight pairs of work gloves should cover us.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—before I note that, can you confirm whether we’re only prioritizing safety-related repairs like space heaters and lamps for this first pass?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, sorry I’m chiming in late, but for this first pass I’d stick to the safety stuff like space heaters and lamps.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
